reciprocal.why: Porges treats respiratory sinus arrhythmia as an index of ventral vagal tone and social engagement, while critics call equating RSA with cardiac vagal tone a category mistake (Ryle, 1949)
the theory adds a proposed mammalian social-communication circuit on top of the classic sympathetic-parasympathetic division
the theory's ventral vagal component is described by Porges as inhibiting sympathetic influences to the heart and dampening the HPA axis
slow breathing's parasympathetic shift is often framed in polyvagal terms, though Zaccaro et al. show the effect stands on its own evidence
HRV biofeedback draws on vagal-tone interpretations of RSA; its best-supported mechanism is baroreflex strengthening (Lehrer & Gevirtz, 2014)
neuroception is neural detection of safety and danger without awareness, distinct from the felt sense of bodily signals
the theory's sociality claim parallels Kok and Fredrickson's finding that vagal tone reciprocally predicts positive emotions and social connectedness
ego development concerns how self-conceptions mature; verification theory concerns how people defend them once formed
the general tendency to favor belief-consistent information, of which self-verification is the self-directed case
the theory's core rationale is that stable, confirmed self-views make the social world predictable
self-verification competes with the self-enhancement motive that anchors classic self-esteem findings
the tilt toward flattering explanations that verification theory predicts can reverse for negative self-views
the theory predicts feedback is accepted insofar as it matches existing self-views
both describe resisting information that threatens an established picture of who one is

notes: 7 PVT reciprocals (first item) + 7 Self-verification reciprocals (second item)
